hits.title: Boeing Acquires Insitu to Expand Capabilities in Unmanned Systems  - Jul 22, 2008
hits.snippet: ST. LOUIS, July 22 / PRNewswire-FirstCall/ -- The Boeing Company (NYSE: BA) today announced an agreement to acquire Insitu, Inc., a pioneer in the unmanned air systems (UAS) market and leader in the design, development and manufacture of high-performance, low-cost UAS used for intelligence, surveillance and reconnaissance (ISR). ... Terms of the cash transaction were not disclosed. This transaction, anticipated to close by the end of September following regulatory approvals, does not affect Boeing's financial guidance. Once acquired, Insitu will be a separate subsidiary under Boeing Integrated Defense Systems' Military Aircraft unit. It will retain an independent operating model while benefiting from Boeing's vast resources.

hits.title: Archer to acquire Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu from Boeing - FlightGlobal
hits.snippet: # Archer to acquire Wisk Aero, SkyGrid and Insitu from Boeing ... Advanced air mobility start-up Archer Aviation has reached a deal to acquire several emerging aerospace technology companies owned by Boeing. ... The agreement covers electric aircraft developer Wisk, uncrewed aerial systems manufacturer Insitu and air traffic management solutions provider SkyGrid. Although the specific terms have not been disclosed, Archer says it has “signed definitive agreements” with Boeing covering the acquisitions. ... An 8-K filing with US securities regulators on 9 August reveals that Boeing will take a nearly 20% ownership stake in Archer via stock transfer in exchange for the three companies. Additionally, Boeing will be granted warrants allowing it to purchase $200 million in Archer stock over the next several years at a fixed price.

hits.title: Insitu
hits.snippet: Insitu was founded in 1994 by engineers interested in creating miniature robotic aircraft. It went on to develop the Aerosonde concept for long-range weather reconnaissance. The company derives its name from the process of measuring the atmosphere in situ (in place), as opposed to remotely, by satellite. At the end of the 1990s the company transitioned to the SeaScan concept for imaging reconnaissance from tuna seiners. With the onset of the Iraq War in 2003, SeaScan turned into ScanEagle, and Insitu focused their efforts on military applications. Insitu was acquired by long-time partner Boeing in 2008. ... In 2015, it acquired the 2d3 company. In addition to its defense business, the company announced the establishment of its commercial business unit, Insitu Commercial, in 2016. ... 9. "Boeing Completes Acquisition of Insitu". The Boeing Company (Press release). PRNewswire-FirstCall. September 9, 2008. Retrieved August 14, 2024.

hits.title: Boeing is selling flying taxi venture Wisk, WA-based Insitu to Archer - oregonlive.com
hits.snippet: Boeing is selling three subsidiaries to Archer Aviation, a California-based company working on so-called flying taxis, drones and artificial intelligence, according to a joint news release from both companies Monday. ... The aerospace giant is selling Wisk, its autonomous flying taxi subsidiary based in California, as well as Washington-based Insitu, which develops unmanned aircraft systems. It is also offloading SkyGrid, its ground-based air traffic management solution headquartered in Texas. ... As part of the deal announced Monday, Boeing will take a stake in Archer and retain access to Wisk’s autonomous flight technology for its current and future aircraft, the companies said. ... Boeing will take a nearly 20% stake in Archer, according to Archer’s financial statements publicized Monday. ... Insitu, based in Bingen, Klickitat County, and part of Boeing’s defense business, has offices in the U.S., Australia, the UK and the UAE. It has manufactured more than 3,500 unmanned aircraft systems and generates $200 million in annual revenue, according to the news release published Monday.
